findings.description: At 00:00 the middle cup holds a stack of embossed gold coins up to its brim. No hand touches this cup; the hand only works the front-left cup. Yet by 00:02.5 the stack sits clearly lower in the cup, and at 00:03.0 the top coin has changed from an embossed gold coin to a plain silver disc. The contents' level and identity change with no visible action.

At 00:09.0 four cups stand together on the felt (back, left-rear, front-left, front-right). From 00:09.25 to 00:09.75 only three cups are visible: back, left and front-right. Both hands are beside or above the cups and none lifts or moves one, and nothing in front of the group could hide a cup. One cup seems to vanish.
